title: Replace and Install Tote Detect Sensor (M3 screws + M8 connector) and Restart Operator Station
summary: Remove and replace the tote detect sensor by disconnecting the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw, routing the replacement sensor through the frame (using the M8 connector/tape method), reinstalling grommets, mounting with M3 socket-head screws, reconnecting the M8 connector, and restarting the operator station so the sensor is ready for tote detection.
when_to_use: Use when a tote detect sensor must be replaced and reinstalled with the correct M3 socket-head screws and M8 connector, including routing through the frame and reinstalling grommets, followed by restarting the operator station.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs LOTO on the tipper, performs sensor removal/installation, and restarts the operator station.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before disconnecting/removing the tote detect sensor and before restarting the operator station after work is complete (manual references "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout").
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper/operator station area

access_required: Physical access to the tipper/operator station area
system_preconditions: Tipper is placed under LOTO prior to sensor removal/disconnection.
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual v3: section 7.3.2.3.1 REMOVAL and 7.3.2.3.2 INSTALLATION (pages 109-110) and "Starting The Operator Station" (page 66) and "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" (page 2).

visual_references.description: Example of a maintenance procedure that includes the manual instruction to re-start the operator station ("Re-start the operator station (see \"Starting The Operator Station\" on page 66)"). Use only as contextual evidence that restart is part of maintenance workflows; not a tote-sensor-specific restart control image.
Sensor wiring/connection diagram context for sensor installation and restart instruction (A-axis PCA connections; includes "Re-start the operator station").

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely locked out before disconnecting and removing the tote detect sensor.
steps.instruction: Apply LOTO to the tipper using the manual procedure referenced as "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout".
steps.expected_result: Tipper is under LOTO prior to disconnecting the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is in place before any sensor disconnection/removal actions are performed.
steps.failure_condition: Attempting to disconnect/remove the sensor without LOTO applied.

actions.label: Apply tipper LOTO
actions.exact_action: Perform LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If LOTO cannot be applied/verified, stop and do not proceed with sensor disconnection/removal.

steps.title: Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw from the tote detect sensor
steps.purpose: Free the tote detect sensor for removal by disconnecting its electrical connector and mechanical fastener.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the M8 connector and the M3 socket-head screw from the tote detect sensor.
steps.expected_result: M8 connector is disconnected and the M3 socket-head screw is removed/loosened such that the sensor can be pulled out.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor is mechanically and electrically disconnected (M8 connector disconnected; M3 socket-head screw disconnected).
steps.failure_condition: Sensor cannot be pulled out because the M8 connector or M3 socket-head screw is still connected/secured.

actions.label: Disconnect M8 connector
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the M8 connector ... from the tote detect sensor.

actions.label: Disconnect M3 socket-head screw
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the ... M3 socket-head screw ... from the tote detect sensor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the sensor cannot be disconnected cleanly, stop and re-check wiring/routing before continuing.

steps.title: Pull the sensor out
steps.purpose: Remove the old tote detect sensor from the frame for replacement.
steps.instruction: Pull the tote detect sensor out after disconnecting the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw.
steps.expected_result: Old tote detect sensor is removed from the frame.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor is fully removed with no remaining mechanical/electrical attachment.
steps.failure_condition: Sensor resists removal due to remaining attachment or routing obstruction.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the sensor cannot be pulled out, stop and re-check that the M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw are fully disconnected.

steps.title: Route the replacement sensor through the frame using the M8 connector/tape method
steps.purpose: Ensure the replacement sensor wire is routed correctly through the frame to reach the M8 connector location.
steps.instruction: Route the replacement sensor through the frame by taping the replacement sensor to the M8 connector so the old sensor can be used to route the new sensor through the frame.
steps.expected_result: Replacement sensor is routed through the frame to the correct termination point for the M8 connector.
steps.healthy_condition: Replacement sensor wire reaches the M8 connector area without being pinched or misrouted.
steps.failure_condition: Replacement sensor cannot be routed to the termination point or routing is incorrect such that the sensor cannot be mounted/connected.

actions.label: Tape replacement sensor to M8 connector
actions.exact_action: Tape the replacement sensor to the M8 connector so the old sensor can be used to route the new sensor through the frame.

stop_or_escalate_if: If routing is difficult or incorrect, stop and use the grommet-removal approach in the next step.

steps.title: If routing is difficult, pull grommets from the frame and re-install later
steps.purpose: Provide additional access to route the sensor wire when the frame routing is difficult.
steps.instruction: If routing is difficult, pull the grommets from the frame to make routing easier, then re-install them later.
steps.expected_result: Sensor routing is completed successfully; grommets are available to be re-installed after routing.
steps.healthy_condition: Grommets are removed only as needed to enable routing and are ready to be reinstalled after the sensor is routed.
steps.failure_condition: Grommets are not reinstalled later or routing is completed with grommets missing.

actions.label: Assess routing difficulty
actions.exact_action: If routing is difficult, pull the grommets from the frame to make routing easier, then re-install them later.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot route the sensor even after pulling grommets, stop and re-check wiring/routing before proceeding to mounting.

steps.title: Mount the sensor using the M3 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Secure the replacement tote detect sensor mechanically to the correct mounting location.
steps.instruction: Mount the replacement sensor using the M3 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: Sensor is physically mounted using the M3 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Sensor is securely mounted with M3 socket-head screws (no looseness).
steps.failure_condition: Sensor cannot be mounted securely with the M3 socket-head screws.

actions.label: Install M3 screws
actions.exact_action: Mount the sensor using the M3 socket-head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring/routing if the sensor cannot be mounted securely with the M3 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Connect the M8 connector
steps.purpose: Restore electrical connection for the tote detect sensor.
steps.instruction: Connect the M8 connector to the tote detect sensor.
steps.expected_result: M8 connector is connected to the tote detect sensor.
steps.healthy_condition: M8 connector is fully seated/connected (no loose connection).
steps.failure_condition: M8 connector cannot be connected or remains loose.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the M8 connector cannot be connected, stop and re-check wiring/routing before proceeding.

steps.title: Seat the small grommet around the wire back into the valve cover slot
steps.purpose: Restore wire strain relief and sealing by correctly seating the grommet in the valve cover.
steps.instruction: Put the small grommet around the wire back into the slot in the valve cover.
steps.expected_result: Small grommet is seated in the valve cover slot with the wire passing through it.
steps.healthy_condition: Grommet is seated in the valve cover slot (wire is properly supported).
steps.failure_condition: Grommet cannot be seated back into the valve cover slot.

actions.label: Re-seat small grommet
actions.exact_action: Put the small grommet around the wire back into the slot in the valve cover.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring/routing if the grommet cannot be seated back into the valve cover slot.

steps.title: Re-install any removed grommets
steps.purpose: Ensure all grommets removed to aid routing are restored to maintain proper wire management.
steps.expected_result: All grommets that were removed for routing are re-installed.
steps.healthy_condition: No grommets remain missing from the frame where they were removed.
steps.failure_condition: Any removed grommets are left uninstalled.
stop_or_escalate_if: If any grommets cannot be reinstalled, stop and re-check routing before restarting the operator station.

steps.title: Re-start the operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the operator station back online after sensor replacement so the tote detect sensor is ready for detection.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station using the manual procedure "Starting The Operator Station".
steps.expected_result: Operator station is restarted after the sensor is installed and connected.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station restart completes successfully using the documented restart procedure.
steps.failure_condition: Operator station cannot be restarted using the documented "Starting The Operator Station" procedure.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the operator station cannot be restarted using the documented "Starting The Operator Station" procedure.

success_criteria: Replacement tote detect sensor is physically mounted using M3 socket-head screws.
M8 connector is connected to the tote detect sensor.
Small grommet is seated in the valve cover slot around the wire.
healthy_conditions: Sensor is securely mounted with M3 socket-head screws.
Small grommet is seated in the valve cover slot.
failure_conditions: Sensor cannot be mounted securely with the M3 socket-head screws.
Grommet cannot be seated back into the valve cover slot.
Operator station cannot be restarted using the documented "Starting The Operator Station" procedure.
escalation_guidance: If the operator station cannot be restarted using the documented "Starting The Operator Station" procedure, escalate per site support process.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: 7.3.2.3.1 REMOVAL and 7.3.2.3.2 INSTALLATION include: LOTO tipper; disconnect M8 connector and M3 socket-head screw; pull sensor out; route replacement sensor through frame using tape-to-M8 connector method; optionally pull grommets to ease routing; mount with M3 socket-head screws; connect M8 connector; seat small grommet into valve cover slot; re-install removed grommets; re-start operator station (see page 66).
